A three-horned individual was a '''member''' of the [[Ante-Endor Association]].

==Biography==
The individual was part of the [[Ante-Endor Association]], found on the planet [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]]. The Association was a pro-Imperial organization, which claimed that the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] was a piece of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] propaganda and insisted that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was still operating at full strength. Along with some other members of the organization; including two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and a green pachydermoid being, he tried to beat up [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. He later helped with the cleanup of Mrlssi.

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified individual was created by ''Star Wars'' artists [[Edvin Biuković|Edvin Biukovic]] and [[John Nadeau]] for [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 5|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 5]] of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair]]'' series of comics, published in [[1996]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]].
